newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares slide on institutional profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares slide on institutional profit-taking.

text.p: Profit-taking by institutional investors and speculators pushed down share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange on Friday, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 14.17 points lower at 921.00 points.

"After witnessing a long spell of bull-phase, the market should see some correction and might continue for some more sessions as some stocks are in an overbought position," said B.K. Nagpaul of brokers B.B. Portfolio.
Another broker said selling by domestic financial institutions also dampened the prices.
Reliance Industries fell 4.20 rupees to 361.20 on profit-taking by speculators, brokers said.
State Bank of India slipped 0.25 rupee to 351.50.
